name: Comic Vine
description: Comic Vine, the comic book database, for the Comic Vine Covers: the API key and the answers it keeps, shared by every task.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your Comic Vine key. It is free for personal use: sign in and the key is on the API page. Test asks Comic Vine whether it accepts the key.

properties.name: volumeCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Series Searches (hours)
properties.description: How long what Comic Vine answered for a series search is kept and shared by every task. Series do not change often. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: issuesCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Issue Lists (hours)
properties.description: How long what Comic Vine answered for a page of a series' issues is kept and shared by every task. Comic Vine limits how many requests an hour may make. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After (days)
properties.description: A kept answer nobody has used for this many days (a series you stopped showing) is removed. 0: never.
